name: Beta Calibration
tagline: Logistic regression on (log p, log(1-p)) features — learns a 2-parameter Beta link to remap probabilities.
diff_from_baseline: Kull, Silva Filho & Flach 2017 (AISTATS). Two-parameter Beta family generalizes Platt scaling beyond sigmoid; fits via logistic regression on (log p, log(1-p)). Standard reference for binary post-hoc calibration.

name: Group T-Scaling (JS shrink)
tagline: Per-group temperature fit, then James-Stein-style log-space shrinkage toward the global temperature.

key_hyperparams.name: min n_g
key_hyperparams.role: fall back to global if subgroup too small

diff_from_baseline: Subgroup variant of Guo et al. 2017 (Pira et al. 2024 group-wise). Per-group temperatures avoid one-size-fits-all calibration; James-Stein shrinkage in log-space prevents overfitting on small subgroups under shift.

name: Isotonic Regression
tagline: Non-parametric monotonic remapping of predicted probability to label rate; piecewise-constant.
pseudocode:
1. Sort calibration pairs by score $p_i$
2. Fit non-decreasing piecewise-constant $f$ minimizing $\sum_i (f(p_i)-y_i)^2$ via Pool Adjacent Violators
3. Constrain $y_{\min}=0,\,y_{\max}=1$, out_of_bounds="clip"
4. At test time: $\hat p = f(p)$, clipped to $[\epsilon,1-\epsilon]$
diff_from_baseline: Zadrozny & Elkan 2002 (KDD). Most flexible non-parametric calibrator: monotone piecewise-constant via PAV. Standard baseline; can overfit small calibration sets.

name: Temperature Scaling
tagline: Single scalar temperature on logits, fit by NLL minimization on calibration set; ignores subgroup IDs.
diff_from_baseline: Guo, Pleiss, Sun & Weinberger 2017 (ICML). Default post-hoc calibrator: a single temperature scaling logits preserves accuracy and reduces ECE; standard baseline before any subgroup-aware method.
